column.text: Bitcoin surged decisively five point two five percent today to close near eighty one thousand three hundred dollars driven by a massive short squeeze that liquidated over one hundred million dollars of leveraged positions while ETF inflows added another one hundred and one million. This confluence points to a short squeeze fueled rally rather than pure organic demand expansion as the liquidation cascade forced price higher creating a feedback loop where new buyers entered chasing the breakout above eighty one thousand. Whale positioning on Hyperliquid shows significant net long exposure for BTC reinforcing this bullish bias while dollar liquidity remains flat offering no macro tailwind or headwind either way so traders must focus entirely on internal price structure.
